build.recipe: Build the base test ROM from the pinned revision with the pinned Rust nightly and nust64 in a separate fixture lane (upstream: cargo run --release). The core build never runs it.

entries.rights_evidence: Decision D2 (owner stop): the rights of this upstream repository and of its built ROM are not documented, so both stay pending and the ROM stays local-only: never committed, never uploaded, never used in public CI. The owner decides after a per-asset rights audit. Revision pin: upstream HEAD read with git ls-remote on 2026-11-10 (UTC) was 9a8b9f7d94ee2f6f57d7feed70c98c22cdc30e6c, the same revision the phase research recorded as upstream HEAD (a commit dated 2026-09-08), so the pin did not move. The digest stays null until two clean builds on separate machines agree (research item: reproducibility unknown).

entries.forbidden_reason: Nintendo PIF, IPL and CIC boot data is protected material (docs/policy/rights-and-fixtures.md). It is never committed, uploaded or used in public CI, and no digest of it is recorded here. The boot route is a high-level or clean-room replacement.
Commercial cartridge ROM images are protected material (docs/policy/rights-and-fixtures.md). They are never committed, uploaded or used in public CI, and no digest of any of them is recorded here.
